age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 50 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Uttar Pradesh Government rules for SC/ST/OBC and other categories. 5 years for permanent UP Govt employees with 3 years service. Age relaxation for ex-servicemen as per rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Recognized MBBS or equivalent, Postgraduate Degree or Diploma in General Medicine, 3 years experience after PG diploma
qualification.details: A recognized medical qualification included in the First or Second Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (Now National Medical Commission Act-2019). Postgraduate Degree or diploma in the concerned specialty (General Medicine). Three years experience in concerned specialty after obtaining the postgraduate diploma.

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.sgpgims.org.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SGPGIMS Specialist Medical Officer Gr.-II (General Medicine) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the SGPGIMS Specialist Medical Officer Gr.-II (General Medicine) recruitment is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Specialist Medical Officer Gr.-II post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Specialist Medical Officer Gr.-II (General Medicine) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC/ST candidates is Rs. 708.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Specialist Medical Officer Gr.-II post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 67700 to Rs. 208700 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for the Specialist Medical Officer Gr.-II (General Medicine) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a recognized MBBS degree, a Postgraduate Degree or Diploma in General Medicine, and three years of experience after the postgraduate diploma.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply offline by sending the filled application form along with required documents to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation provided?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per Uttar Pradesh Government rules for SC/ST/OBC and other categories, including permanent UP Govt employees and ex-servicemen.

faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of SGPGIMS, www.sgpgims.org.in.
